ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The food web diagram shows several organisms and food sources, including a white tailed deer and a plant item labeled "berries." The white tailed deer is connected to berries in the food web, indicating that the deer receives food or energy from berries. Reasoning: The question asks which group the white tailed deer can be categorized under. Berries are plant material, and an animal that eats plants or plant parts is categorized as a herbivore. Therefore, the white tailed deer belongs to the herbivores group.
